item.tib: pha rgyud rig pa khu byug gsang mchog mthar thug rgyal po rtsa ba'i rgyud las dbang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: dbalaM gsang mchog rig pa khu byug bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung las/ gud du phyung ba dbang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu zhes bya ba/ gshen 'chi med gtsug phud kyi lung don/ gsaMng ba 'dus pa'i man ngag stag la me 'bar gyi mnga' gsol/ lha klu mi gsum la gdams pa'o/ lha klu mi gsum gyi zhal nas/ 'di 'dra'i gdams pa khyad par can/ 'jig rten gsum na dkon pa'i nor/ yid bzhin nor bu rin chen 'dra/ phal dang phal gyis spyod yul min/ zhes gsungs nas/ gshen nam mkha' snang ba mdog can la brgyud do/ des lho yi gshen gsum/ des zhang zhung gi gshen gsum/ des dmu gshen dran pa/ des rje blon stang gsum/ ra sangs khod ram dang bzhi la brgyud pa'o/ dbang rgyud yid bzhin nor bu rdzogs so//
